themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously, including exploration, data gathering, and analysis with varying degrees of human oversight.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, including security aspects and performance benchmarks.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the use of AI-generated users or data to simulate human behavior for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Details specific AI-powered platforms, software, and frameworks designed to aid researchers in various disciplines.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Examines AI's role in analyzing user sentiment, feedback, and opinions from various sources to inform product and service improvements.

themes.name: AI for design research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that directly support or transform the design process, from ideation to prototyping and refinement.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Investigates how AI is used to conduct and analyze qualitative research, including interviews and thematic analysis.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers the application of AI to automate various testing processes, from software development to network and system validation.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Compares the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI tools used for research purposes.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Details how AI is being used to conduct market research, analyze product performance, and identify new product opportunities.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
